function.arguments: {"message":"Sure! To trigger a test webhook manually, go to your account’s Settings → Developer → Webhooks. From there you’ll see a **Send test event** button. Clicking it will fire a realistic sample payload to the endpoint you’ve configured, using the same schema, headers, and signing header as a live delivery. The delivery will be logged in the webhook delivery log and marked as a test delivery, so you can confirm the endpoint responded with a 2xx before you enable production traffic."}

arguments.message: Sure! To trigger a test webhook manually, go to your account’s Settings → Developer → Webhooks. From there you’ll see a **Send test event** button. Clicking it will fire a realistic sample payload to the endpoint you’ve configured, using the same schema, headers, and signing header as a live delivery. The delivery will be logged in the webhook delivery log and marked as a test delivery, so you can confirm the endpoint responded with a 2xx before you enable production traffic.
